definitions.explanation: A polite, euphemistic term for a restroom or bathroom, commonly seen on signs in public buildings, department stores, hotels, and restaurants.

examples.japanese: {化粧室|けしょうしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
{化粧室|けしょうしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二階|にかい}→二階：27513_nikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: The restroom is on the second floor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{化粧室|けしょうしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{寄|よ}って→立ち寄る：04638_tachiyoru⟧⟦{身|み}だしなみ→身だしなみ：14286_midashinami⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}えた→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: Before the meeting, I stopped by the powder room to freshen up.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
⟦{化粧|けしょう}→化粧：02699_keshou⟧ (makeup, grooming) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). Literally "grooming room" — a euphemistic way of saying toilet or bathroom.

REGISTER:
This is a polite, indirect term for a restroom. It is commonly seen on signs in upscale venues. In everyday conversation, ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧ or ⟦お{手洗|てあら}い→お手洗い：02861_otearai⟧ are more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {化粧室|けしょうしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧ (to go to the restroom)
- {化粧室|けしょうしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to excuse oneself to the restroom)
- {女性用化粧室|じょせいようけしょうしつ} (women's restroom)
